title: Aerobic Exercise and Oxygen Uptake Efficiency Slope in Coronary Artery Disease
brief_summary: Thus, the purpose of the present study was to evaluate the effects of continuos exercise training (CET) and interval exercise trainining (IET) on oxygen uptake efficiency slope (OUES) in patients with coronary artery disease.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* stable coronary artery disease diagnosed by coronary angiography

Exclusion Criteria:

* unstable angina pectoris,
* complex ventricular arrhythmias,
* pulmonary congestion and
* orthopaedic or neurological limitations to exercise
